desc: Ideation: derive per-run cost `L // (k+1)` for k ≥ 2 and the alternating-pattern cost for k = 1

Write the complete `Solution.minLength` implementation (runs helper, `cost(k)` with k==1 special case, linear scan over k) and verify on the three examples plus edge cases ("0110"/1→2, "0000"/0→4, "1"/0→1, "01"/1→1, numOps=n)
Verify correctness of the cost formula (f ≥ ceil((L−k)/(k+1)) = floor(L/(k+1))) and monotonicity of cost in k — confirmed analytically; brute-force cross-validation unnecessary
Binary-search optimization deemed unnecessary (O(n²) ≤ 10⁶ for n = 1000)
